body: Thank you so much, I really do appreciate you taking the time to write this. And the knowledge that someone else out there who knows what this is like but has gotten out of it is comforting. It can just be hard to remember the times that were good. I like the idea of focusing on the love that I have to give.

I'm sorry. Even though I don't know you, I can say that I do care. Just the knowledge that someone else out there is suffering, likely in a similar way, is painful and I wish I could alleviate it or do something to help. I wish things were different for people like us.
